judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a cow with clearly recognizable bovine features, including a body, head, four legs, tail, and udder.
requirements.note: No udder is drawn under the belly, and only three legs are present (three hooves in the render).

requirements.text: The cow must have black and white patches for its coloring.
requirements.note: The cow is red-brown with cream patches; no black patches anywhere on the body.

requirements.text: Add cow ears, eyes, and snout for facial recognition.
Position the cow in a realistic plowing stance, leaning forward as if pulling.
The cow's hooves must be colored brown, as if covered in soil from the field.
Include a traditional wooden plow with a visible metal blade/share.
Depict a wooden yoke across the cow's shoulders, connected to the plow by visible chains.
requirements.note: A brown wooden yoke does sit across the shoulders, but the two traces running back to the plow are smooth thin gold lines with no links; no chains are visible.

requirements.text: The plow's blade must be partially buried in the soil, actively turning over a chunk of earth.
requirements.note: The share is drawn fully above the soil with its whole outline visible; nothing occludes it, there is no trench or mound at its edge, and it does not cross below any soil surface line.

requirements.text: Show at least three distinct, dark furrows in the soil trailing directly behind the plow.
requirements.note: The field's furrow lines are drawn LIGHTER than the surrounding soil; only about two bands read as darker than the field, short of the three dark furrows required.

requirements.text: The field must be split into a plowed section and an unplowed section, with the cow and plow positioned at the boundary between them.
requirements.note: The entire field is bare brown soil edge to edge; the green is distant hills beyond the horizon, not an unplowed section of the field, so there is no boundary for the cow and plow to stand at.

requirements.text: The unplowed section of the field must have short green grass, which is visibly being overturned by the plow.
requirements.note: There is no green grass anywhere in the field - the whole field is bare soil - so nothing green is being overturned.

requirements.text: Add a simple background with a clear horizon line and a blue sky containing a yellow sun.
